about: The Launch bench: one ranked 'do this first' list for the Herd's product launch (raven575 lost their job 2026-11-19; goal: launch vCGE and earn). Steps 1-9 are raven575's own human steps; 10+ are what teams are doing. Built from HQ-0342 replies, the Launch Board and the app-store plan. Update by editing this file and rerunning the installer; ticks match by id + step number.
title: Do This First
intro: Breathe. One thing at a time, top to bottom. Team vCGE's top 3 come first, then each team's #1 (Marketing's listing review is critical path), then the rest of your steps; done ones sit just below them, then everything the teams are already doing.

items.title: 🟢 Play closed test: in Google review
items.why: vCGE's most important item. The app is in Google's review since 23:04 UTC 11-19. Next: add the vcge-testers group to the closed test track, and make the merge call on the store-setup PR #53. The closed test starts the 14-day tester clock.
steps: Finish the identity and phone checks Play asks for.
Set up the payments profile as Herd of Helpers (you need it to sell a paid app).
Create app: name vCGE, App, Paid.
Testing, Closed testing: create the track and add the vcge-testers Google Group.
Fill the App content forms (privacy policy, Data safety, content rating). The 🐢 app-store thread has the answers ready.

steps.text: Make the merge call on store-setup PR #53 (https://github.com/real-raven575/vCGE-Master/pull/53) when its checks are green.

items.title: 🐢 Store builds: Play bundle + Windows package (PR #53)
items.why: Builds the files both stores take, with the privacy policy and listing text.

steps.text: Get PR #53 CI green 11/11, then ready for review.
Sign with the Play key once it's in place (step 5); add the Microsoft identity after step 7.

items.title: 💾 Free up Google storage (90% full)
items.why: vCGE's second most important item. Google is at 90%; at 100% Gmail stops getting mail, including store and account emails. Gmail cleanup is running now (about 2,540 emails, about 222 MB to Trash, undo available). Next: rclone config and the Survey on Beastly.

steps.text: Team eMail cleans Gmail junk first (old promotions, big attachments, newsletters). Nothing personal is deleted without your yes.
Set up rclone on Beastly and run the Survey (the eMail thread gives you the lines).
Start Google Takeout for old mail and photos: https://takeout.google.com
Move the Takeout files into Nextcloud and check they open before anything is removed from Google.

items.title: 📣 Public Herd refresh: README and wiki updates
items.why: vCGE's third most important item. The public README and wiki updates are ready and wait on your push card.

steps.text: Answer the push card for the README and wiki updates (Yes, No, or explain by voice).
After your yes, the team pushes and checks the public pages.

items.title: 🦚 CRITICAL PATH: store listing review + 14-day tester note
items.why: The Play listing and the tester note have not started; they wait on your go. From each team's reply to raven575's 11-20 poke (notes/flight-deck/2026-11-20-test-bench-team-items.md). (MKTG-0025)

steps.text: Give Marketing your go in the Marketing thread.
Marketing reviews the listing and writes the 14-day tester note.

items.title: 🐼 vCGE store art: built, copy it to vcge-drop
items.why: 50 files built at 00:52 UTC (Drive: TEAM_Creative > 10 vCGE > 'vCGE store art HQ-0342 2026-11-20'). The copy to vcge-drop waits on your okay for the device step. (CRTV-0074)

steps.text: Okay the device step in Creative's thread.
Creative copies the art to vcge-drop.

items.title: 🐒 Auto-Fixer: test the log redaction fix (PR #39) on BEASTLY
items.why: A privacy fix: logs could keep details they should hide. It needs a hand test on BEASTLY. (FIXW-0037)

steps.text: Reply 'go BEASTLY' in the 'Fix log redaction gaps' thread, then run the test it gives you.

items.title: 🐧 HomeLab: Lounge tools v1.1
items.why: The Lounge tools update is ready to install. (HMLB-0068)

steps.text: Type 'yes v1.1' in HomeLab's thread.

items.title: 🦏 Vault: build Vaultwarden, then move the credential files
items.why: Credential files still sit in the synced Team Vault/Claude/ folder. Moving them waits on Vaultwarden, which needs your yes; it also unblocks the password clean-up and the Play key backup. (VALT-0035)

steps.text: Say yes to building Vaultwarden in Vault's thread.
Vault moves the credential files into Vaultwarden.

items.title: 🐜 Finance: launch money, tip-jar checklist
items.why: The tip-jar sign-up checklist is ready; the Bankers still owe the $0.99 price check. (CASH-0034)

steps.text: Say go for each sign-up step in Finance's thread.
Bankers finish the $0.99 check.

items.title: 🐿 History: thank-you letter to former teammates
items.why: One choice: one letter to the group, or separate letters. (HIST-0034)

steps.text: Pick group or separate letters in History's thread.

items.title: 🤖 9to5: mail going outside (security check)
items.why: A read-only check is ready and waits on you running Part A. (WORK-0039)

steps.text: Run Part A from 9to5's thread.

items.title: 🐝 eMail: role addresses bugs@, support@, privacy@
items.why: Planning; your answer is in (Mailbox row 12624). Nothing needed from you right now. (MAIL-0070)

steps.text: eMail finishes the role-address plan.

items.title: 🛡 Set up admin@herdofhelpers.com as the Herd admin login
items.area: 🙋 You · one login for the Herd
items.why: You picked admin@herdofhelpers.com as the Herd-wide admin login, and its mailbox is ready. The vCGE Gmail stays the Play owner; this one does the day-to-day admin and is the public contact.
steps: Make a Google account with it: https://accounts.google.com/signup, then 'Use your existing email'.
Play Console, Users and permissions: invite admin@herdofhelpers.com as Admin. Keep the vCGE Gmail as owner.
Switch the public contact email (Play developer page and store listing) to admin@herdofhelpers.com.
Turn on 2-Step Verification on BOTH accounts and print the backup codes. Keep the paper offline, never in the Herd.
Name Stripe 'Herd of Helpers' too.

items.title: 💛 Tip jar accounts: Stripe, then Sponsors, then Liberapay
items.why: Tips are the fastest money: no store review. PR #51 is ready to switch the links on the moment each account is live.
steps: Stripe: https://dashboard.stripe.com/register (Individual / sole proprietor). Make a Payment Link 'Tip for vCGE', paste the link in the tip-jar thread.
GitHub Sponsors: https://github.com/sponsors/accounts (GitHub reviews it in a few days).
Liberapay: https://liberapay.com/sign-up, connect Stripe only, paste your username in the tip-jar thread.

items.title: 🔑 Make the Play upload key (Protected CI)
items.why: You picked Protected: CI signs a build only after you click Approve. The key backup goes in Vaultwarden once it's built, never GitHub, Drive or Nextcloud.
steps: Make the upload key on your PC with the one line the 🐢 app-store thread gives you.
In GitHub, vCGE-Master, Settings, Environments: create play-upload with you as the required reviewer, and add the key's three secrets there.
Keep a copy on an offline USB until Vaultwarden is ready.

items.title: 🧾 Free EIN (10 minutes)
items.why: Keeps your Social Security number off store, Stripe and tax forms. Free from the IRS; never pay a site for it.
steps: Open https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/get-an-employer-identification-number and apply online (sole proprietor).
Save the letter it gives you to your private files. Do not paste the number anywhere in the Herd.

items.title: 🏪 Reserve the name vCGE in Microsoft Partner Center
items.why: Locks the name and gives the identity values the Windows package needs (PR #53 holds test values until then).
steps: Open https://partner.microsoft.com/dashboard/apps-and-games/overview, then New product, MSIX or PWA app, type vCGE, Reserve.
Copy the Product identity values (Name, Publisher CN=, Store ID 9N...) into the app-store thread. These are safe to share.

items.title: ✅ Quick answers for teams
items.why: 🦏 Deadbolt (Vault) needs a list of which launch accounts exist to start the 2FA check. 🐿 History needs a go for a Nextcloud session to write the Herd story.
steps: Tell 🦏 Deadbolt (Team Vault): the names of the accounts you've made (no passwords).
Say 'go' in 🐿 History's mail thread for their Nextcloud session.
🐧 HomeLab: type your yes for the Lounge tools v1.1 in their thread, and set a fresh Lounge B Nextcloud sync password yourself (never paste it in the Herd).

items.title: 📞 Optional: ask the state unemployment office one question
items.area: 🙋 You · when you have a minute
items.why: Contract work that was promised to become a job may count as misclassification, which can change what you're owed. Worth one call; nothing depends on it.
steps: Call the state unemployment office (the number is in the Rank Herd priorities thread) and ask if your contract work can count as misclassification.

items.title: 👥 Google Group for Play testers: done
items.why: Made: vcge-testers. Join link for 🐼 Creative and 🦚 Marketing to share: https://groups.google.com/g/vcge-testers
steps: Group made with Ask to join (done).

items.title: 🦏 Keys, 2FA check, secret sweep
items.why: Every account gets 2FA and paper recovery codes; nothing secret goes public.

steps.text: Sheriff check on each account you list (step 8).
Read-only secret sweep of repo, listing, screenshots and tester note before anything goes public.

items.title: 🐹 Price, fees and tax-form names
items.why: $0.99 nets about $0.84 a sale. Bankers check store shares and payout forms.

steps.text: Send the fee and tax-form summary on HQ-0342.

items.title: 🐿 Herd story + Meet the Herd
items.why: Story for the tip jar and About pages; one line per character for store pages.

steps.text: Draft after your go (step 8).

items.title: 📬 Waiting on top-3 lists
items.why: 3 of 10 teams have answered HQ-0342 (Vault, History, HomeLab). Left: Creative, Marketing, 9to5, Auto-Fixer, Bankers, eMail, Never Forget. Their items join this list as they answer.
